import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;
        int n, k, p;
        String line = br.readLine();
        st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int nn = n;
        int maxBit = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++) {
            if (((n >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                maxBit = i;
            }
        }
        int[] f = new int[1 << (maxBit + 1)];
        Arrays.fill(f, 0);
        int t = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxBit; j++) {
            t <<= 1;
            if (((n >> j) & 1) == 1) t |= 1;
        }
        int[] a = new int[1 << (maxBit + 1)];
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            a[i] = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            f[i] = i;
        }
        int nnVal = t;

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int) ((long) fac[i - 1] * i % p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }

        a = subsetPowConvol(a, k, p, maxBit + 1);

        int res = fpow(k, n, p);
        int[] aCopy = Arrays.copyOf(a, a.length);
        submod(res, (int) ((long) aCopy[nnVal] * fac[n] % p), p);
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static int fpow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static void addmod(int[] a, int[] b, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            a[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) % p;
        }
    }

    static void submod(int[] a, int[] b, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i] - b[i];
            if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += p;
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPowConvol(int[] a, int k, int p, int maxLog) {
        int n = 1;
        while (n < a.length) n <<= 1;
        int[] res = new int[n];
        Arrays.fill(res, 0);
        int[][] fa = new int[maxLog][n];
        int[][] fc = new int[maxLog][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < maxLog; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = j < a.length ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, false);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[maxLog];
            for (int j = 0; j < maxLog; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            va = powConvol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < maxLog; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < maxLog; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < a.length; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int[] powConvol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) {
            return a;
        } else if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(res, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(res, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * r[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int k = 31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if (((msk >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (!invert) {
                        addmod(a, new int[]{a[pmsk]}, p);
                    } else {
                        submod(a, new int[]{a[pmsk]}, p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
